newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Easdaq says capitalisation tops $1 billion.
newsitem.headline: Easdaq says capitalisation tops $1 billion.

text.p: Easdaq, Europe's new exchange for growth stocks launched in November, said in a statement on Thursday that market capitalisation of shares listed on the electronic exchange passed the $1 billion mark.
Easdaq -- the European Association of Securities Dealers Automated Quotations System -- is modelled on the U.S. Nasdaq exchange.

Easdaq said that U.S.-Swiss pulp and paper products maker Mercer International Inc will begin trading on Easday on Friday. The company is already listed on Nasdaq. The Easdaq listing does not involve an issue of new capital.
Mercer will be Easdaq's fifth listing.
Easdaq said that the numbers of applications for Easdaq listings had accelerated over the past month.
